title: The Morning Digest: October 22, 2026
dek: Saudi authorities confirmed two attacks on Wednesday: a drone interception at the Shaybah processing facility whose debris killed two contractor workers outside the perimeter, with operations unaffected, and an attack on Dammam's King Fahd airport that killed one and injured eight. The US ordered non-emergency staff and families out of its Saudi mission. Brent settled flat Wednesday at $108.82, then bid overnight to $111.64 at 0626 GMT (Reuters), close to a five-month high, on the confirmed attacks and an unconfirmed claim by Iran's Revolutionary Guards that seven vessels were hit or mined. The EIA reported crude down 3.06 Mbbl for the week ending Oct 16 but distillates up 1.68 Mbbl against a polled draw, and the diesel crack closed Wednesday at $102.91. WCS Dec26 settled at -$28.35 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 21), a new widest, with the traded winter strip widening on volume. Russia's deputy prime minister said the first Russian diesel tanker for the US, 40 kt, sails Thursday.
